gao.definition: n an independent nonpartisan federal agency that acts as the investigative arm of Congress making the executive branch accountable to Congress and the government accountable to citizens of the United States
gao.translation: abbr. 总审计局（General Accounting Office）；决算总局（General Accounting Office）

gaol.definition:
n a correctional institution used to detain persons who are in the lawful custody of the government (either accused persons awaiting trial or convicted persons serving a sentence)
v lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
gaol.translation:
n. 监禁, 监狱
vt. 监禁

gaol bird.translation: [法] 囚犯, 惯犯, 流氓

gaol delivery.translation: [法] 提审囚犯出监, 监狱出空

gaolbird.definition: n a criminal who has been jailed repeatedly

gaoled.definition: v lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
gaoled.translation: v. 监禁( gaol的过去式和过去分词 )

gaoler.translation:
n. 监狱看守
[法] 监狱看守

gaoleress.translation:
n. 监狱女看守
[法] 监狱女看守

gaolers.translation: n. <英>狱卒( gaoler的复数形式 )

gaoling.definition: v lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
gaoling.translation: v. 监禁( gaol的现在分词 )

gaols.definition:
n a correctional institution used to detain persons who are in the lawful custody of the government (either accused persons awaiting trial or convicted persons serving a sentence)
v lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
gaols.translation:
n. 监狱, 拘留所( gaol的名词复数 )
v. 监禁( gaol的第三人称单数 )
